text: pe. sammāsamādhi . idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sāmaññaṃ . [104] katamo ca bhikkhave sāmaññattho . yo kho bhikkhave rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo . ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sāmaññatthoti . [105] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . brahmaññañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi #1-2 ma. kho . brahmaññaphalāni ca taṃ suṇātha . [106]
